result:
Spec-04 is implemented and committed in two commits on `new-product-build-1`.

## What shipped

**Invisible layers (`06951ad`)** — the `Editing/` platform-neutral core (model, canonical-JSON codec + hash, session-only history, copy-by-value transfer), v20 `edits`/`edit_versions` + v21 `edit_presets`, `EditRecordStore` wired into all five identity/folder rewrite seams, sidecar edit fields with their own clock, and the Core Image + Metal render pipeline.

**User-visible layers (`f4c0568`)** — `EditStore` + the live provider + the consumer sweep (grid thumbnails, both hero decode rungs, `OutputRender`, PDF), the (Preview | Edit) editor inside the hero viewer, curve editor, WB eyedropper, before/after suite, versions, presets, copy/paste + batch sync, and Edit-a-Copy.

**Verification:** `BUILD SUCCEEDED`, binary mtime confirmed fresh, full suite **1471 tests / 0 failures** — including the prior specs' suites and the phase-3 exit gate (`EditRenderConsistencyTests`).

## Four things worth your attention

- **A real deadlock, caught by a hung test run.** `EditStackIndex.stackHash` held its `NSLock` while calling the provider, which reads the same index. `NSLock` isn't recursive, so this would have hung the main thread on the first edited tile. Fixed and documented.
- **`extern "C" [[stitchable]] float4 name(...)`** — the attribute goes before the return type. After it, the Metal compiler errors and the kernels silently fail to load.
- **One test initially passed vacuously.** `HighlightRecoveryTests` used `CIImage(color:)`, which clamps to 0…1 — both "hot" fixtures collapsed to white before the render started, so of course they matched. Rebuilt on float bitmaps; it now actually pins the scene-referred behaviour.
- **I derived the mired range from the floor** rather than from the plan's 3000 K warm target. The plan's number ran the cool side past the clamp, reproducing exactly the warm/cool asymmetry that mired space exists to remove.

## Two things I could not do

- **`-exportLocalizations` cannot build this project.** `Intelligence/Core/ClipVectors.swift` uses `Float16`, which doesn't exist on x86_64, and the extractor builds universal. This is pre-existing Spec-03 breakage (file unmodified since `2bf7deb`), not from this work. I wrote the 72 new French strings into `Localizable.xcstrings` directly and verified all 728 keys have an `fr` value — but the standard workflow stays blocked until `ClipVectors` is fixed.
- **`EditingModuleImportTests` skips on this machine.** The test host is the sandboxed app, so it can't read a checkout under `~/Documents`. It skips rather than passing vacuously; a green run on a checkout elsewhere is the real gate.

Also not built: the `PerfBaseline` rows for this spec's five measurements (same harness gap Spec 03 left), and stacking the Edit-a-Copy with its parent — recorded as a `TODO`, not stubbed.

The plan calls for hands-on verification of the editor in the running app. I haven't done that — the tests and a fresh build are what I can attest to, and the render pipeline touching Metal/`CIContext` is exactly the class of thing your own notes say to verify in the running app rather than from green tests.
